caption: The drawing depicts a single large stoneware jar placed upright on a plain background. The jar is a beige or light brown color with a smooth surface and a slightly wider top rim that curves outward. On the upper section of the jar, there is an inscription in dark blue or black lettering that reads: “NEW YORK STONE WARE CO. FORT EDWARD, N.Y. 6” along with a small decorative motif resembling a flower. Below the text, there is a painted, stylized dark blue or black design that appears to be a butterfly or floral motif comprising sweeping curves and several dots. Near the bottom edge of the drawing is a horizontal scale marked from 0 to 3, suggesting measurement in inches or centimeters. The background is plain and off-white, and in the bottom right corner, the name "Yolande DuLassus 1888" is written, indicating the artist and date of the drawing.
title: Jar
